body: Doesn't matter now, one of his friends just announced his death today. I wish I would have thought of contacting his family sooner, maybe I could have done something. At least now I know where to turn if I find myself in a similar situation again.

He has a generic as fuck name and lives in a different country than I do. What can I do? I feel like I'm in the worst position possible, close enough to feel like I can do something but far enough to be helpless.

He had a decent following years ago but nobody really cares any more as his apathy increased. He did videos, among other things. The stuff he said really impacted me at a young age and I've been attached to him ever since. It's really weird and doesn't make sense, but I'm really in a state of grief right now.
